detailed_description: The Loan Calculator is a computational tool that performs amortization analysis for fixed and variable interest rate loans using standard financial formulas. It calculates monthly payments using the PMT equation: M = P[r(1+r)^n]/[(1+r)^n-1], where P is principal, r is per-period interest rate, and n is total payments. Users benefit from precise breakdowns of principal and interest components across payment schedules, enabling strategic debt management. The tool handles compounding frequencies (monthly, quarterly, annually) and generates dynamic amortization tables showing remaining balances after each payment. Unique features include support for ad-hoc principal pre-payments and exportable CSV schedule generation. This enables financial professionals, homeowners, and borrowers to model debt scenarios with mathematical precision, compare loan offers, and optimize repayment strategies.
usage_steps: Input loan principal amount in the 'Principal Value' numeric field
Enter annual percentage rate (APR) using the rate adjustment slider or manual percentage entry
Set loan duration using the dual-selector for years/months
Choose compounding interval via radio buttons (monthly/quarterly/semiannual/annual)
Activate calculation engine by clicking the 'Generate Amortization Table' button
Access schedule details in the interactive grid and use 'Export CSV' for permanent records
usage_examples: A mortgage broker calculating monthly payments for a $420,000 home loan at 4.25% APR over 30 years with monthly compounding
A small business owner comparing 5-year equipment financing options at 6.5% APR versus 7.25% APR with quarterly compounding
A student loan borrower analyzing the impact of $100 monthly extra payments on a $65,000 loan at 5.8% APR over 15 years
An automotive buyer evaluating refinancing possibilities for a $22,000 car loan at 8.5% APR versus a new 6.9% APR offer with reduced term
